en.headline: Seamless waybill sorter switching
notes: Language and theme changes now refresh the Waybill Sorter controls in place, without closing or reopening the app.
Header controls and translated statistic labels keep stable sizes when switching between English and Chinese.
Version advanced to 0.4.3 for the in-app update checker.

zh.headline: 运单排序工具无缝切换
notes: 切换语言或主题时，现在会直接更新运单排序工具中的控件，不再关闭或重新打开应用。
在英文和中文之间切换时，页眉控件和统计标签会保持稳定尺寸。
版本已更新至 0.4.3，供应用内更新检查器使用。
